Given a FlareUploadContext - the file, a progress sink and a cancellation token - send the bytes however the application sends bytes, and report the running total to Progress. Inherited from `FlareFileUploadBase`. |
|  |  |  |  |  | A delegate rather than a URL on purpose. A URL plus headers cannot express a token that refreshes mid-upload, a presigned PUT, a resumable protocol or an application's own retry policy - and an upload component that gets those wrong is one an application has to wrap. Flare owns the queue, the concurrency, the cancellation and the whole visual state; the application owns the wire. Leave it null and the component is exactly what it was before: a file picker. |
